title: Vex — A beautiful Excel and CSV viewer built in Go.  #github #excel #terminal

sections.title: Transcript
paragraphs: Vex, a beautiful Excel and CSV viewer built in Go. Yep, Excel in your terminal, but actually gorgeous. Pick from six stunning themes. Catputen, Nord, Rosé Pine, Tokyo Knight, Groove Box, even Dracula. Navigation, smooth, vim keys, arrow keys, global search, and fast sheet switching. Copy cells, export to CSV or JSON, toggle formulas, all without leaving the terminal.
